description: On the pink bedsheet in front of you, there’s a white AirPods case and a white charging connector with a cable trailing off to the right. The left hand moves in and picks up the AirPods case, while the right hand slides the connector toward it and aligns it; the right hand presses the connector into the bottom of the case as the left hand steadies the case, leaving the AirPods case and connector as a two-hand object.
